shared_elements: upright stone slab / monolithic vertical monument
frontal human figure carved in relief occupying the full slab
large headdress or headgear filling the upper zone
circular disc or medallion on the chest
arms held across the torso with hands/forearms near the waist
curvilinear, scroll-like ornamental motifs around the figure
justification: Both are tall, roughly rectangular upright stones carved on the front face with a single frontal figure whose head sits under a broad headdress, with a circular chest ornament and forearms crossed at the waist above a plain base — a fairly specific shared compositional scheme. The rendering differs sharply: A is shallow, worn, sparse and rounded, with large blank areas, while B is dense, deeply undercut and crowded with intricate scroll and mask detail (and is a line engraving rather than a photograph of the object).
